notices.cmd.board: /aboard here | remove | list - stand a notice board in front of you, take away the one in front of you, or list them
notices.cmd.notice: /anotice list | remove <number> - list the notices up on every board with who pinned them, or take one down
notices.not_in_world: You have to be in the world to stand a notice board.
notices.board_placed: A notice board stands here now (#{id}).
notices.board_place_failed: The notice board could not be saved, so none stands here. Try again in a moment.
notices.none_in_front: No notice board stands in front of you.
notices.board_removed: Notice board #{id} is gone, and its notices with it.
notices.board_remove_failed: Notice board #{id} could not be taken away and still stands. Try again in a moment.
notices.notices_empty: No notice is up on any board.
notices.notice_remove_failed: Notice #{id} could not be taken down. Try again in a moment.
notices.posted: Your notice is up on the board.

notices.too_short.one: A notice needs at least {count} letter.
notices.too_short.other: A notice needs at least {count} letters.

notices.too_long.one: A notice holds at most {count} letter.
notices.too_long.other: A notice holds at most {count} letters.

notices.too_many.one: You have {count} notice up already, as many as one may. Take it down first.
notices.too_many.other: You have {count} notices up already, as many as one may. Take one down first.

notices.too_soon: You can pin another notice in {minutes} min.
notices.busy: Someone is pinning a notice to this board. Try again in a moment.
notices.failed: The notice could not be pinned. Try again in a moment.
notices.not_yours: That notice is not yours, or it is down already.
notices.take_down_failed: The notice could not be taken down. Try again in a moment.
notices.closed_far: You walked more than {metres} m away from the notice board.
notices.closed_not_in_world: You left the world, so the notice board closed.
